transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Severus. Thank you for coming in so promptly. Please, have a seat. I've had a moment to review the initial scans of... the Mark. The situation is a little more complex than we anticipated. The Mark's magical signature is... changing. I can't tell whether it's reacting to something external or whether the curse itself is evolving. Your core magic appears stable, which is a positive sign, but I need to run deeper diagnostic charms that will take several days and may be uncomfortable. I cannot yet tell you whether this is dangerous.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: What exactly do you mean by 'changing'? And why would the Mark evolve?

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: By 'changing,' I mean its resonant frequency and magical emission patterns are fluctuating in ways we haven't observed before in subjects carrying the Mark. It's not a simple static signature any longer; there's a dynamic shift occurring. As for *why* it would evolve, that's precisely the central question we need to answer. Dark magic, particularly of this potency and malevolence, is rarely inert. It adapts, it seeks new pathways, especially when it's tied to such a powerful entity as the Dark Lord. It could be reacting to a resurgence of his power, a new magical influence impacting it, or simply a natural, insidious progression of the curse itself over time. That's what these deeper diagnostics are designed to uncover.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Insidious progression, you say. Delightful. So, not only do I have to endure the constant presence of this... Mark, but it may also be subtly mutating within me. How absolutely... charming. Well, proceed with your diagnostics, but ensure that you do not alert anyone to this... situation. I trust your discretion, but we both know how quickly such news could spread.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
Understood, Severus. My discretion is absolute, as you know. What happens within these walls, particularly concerning such sensitive matters, remains here. I can assure you that the details of your condition will not leave this room, nor will they be recorded in any manner accessible to unauthorized personnel. We maintain the strictest protocols for cases involving unique and powerful dark magic.

Regarding the discomfort, these charms are intricate and will delve deep into the magical matrices of your being, specifically isolating the Mark's influence from your own core magic. It's a delicate process, but necessary for a precise understanding. Are you ready to begin, or do you have any other immediate concerns?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Other concerns? The only concern I have is that this... condition does not impact my ability to perform my duties. I assume these diagnostics will not render me... incapacitated for an extended period? I cannot afford to be absent from Hogwarts, nor can I risk appearing... compromised in any way. The students, the staff, the... Order, all depend on me.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
Your ability to perform your duties is, of course, a primary consideration, Severus. The diagnostics will indeed take several days to complete, as they are not instantaneous. We'll be using a series of charms that work cumulatively, allowing us to gather data without continuously bombarding your system.

To be precise, you will need to remain here in a private ward for the initial phase, which will be the most intensive. During this period, you may experience significant magical drain, and some physical discomfort – a sensation akin to an intense magical probe, perhaps a deep chill or a burning localized to the Mark. This could last for up to 24 to 36 hours. After this initial phase, you will be able to return to Hogwarts. However, we will need you to return daily for shorter follow-up scans and to monitor any changes. These subsequent visits would be far less disruptive, perhaps an hour or two each day for the next three to four days.

You would not be 'incapacitated' in the sense of being bed-ridden for weeks, but the initial phase will certainly require you to be here. We can arrange for your absence to be covered by a standard medical leave, citing a magically induced respiratory ailment, perhaps, which would explain a temporary loss of voice or needing to avoid strenuous activity. It's a common enough, discreet explanation for needing quiet and rest away from the school.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: A respiratory ailment, you say? How... very... imaginative. I suppose that will have to suffice. I assume the privacy of my ward here at St. Mungo's can be... guaranteed? And that no... uninvited guests will be allowed entry? I have no desire to explain my presence here, especially not to anyone from the Dark Lord's ranks. It's imperative that my location and condition remain strictly confidential.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
Absolutely, Severus. Your privacy in the ward will be guaranteed. It will be a private room, shielded with the highest-level anti-detection and privacy charms available to St. Mungo's. No one, absolutely no one, will be granted access without your explicit verbal permission, or without coming directly through me first. Even then, I would only facilitate if it were a matter of extreme medical urgency, and only after consulting with you.

Entry logs for such a ward are exceptionally restricted, accessible only to myself and a single, highly vetted Healer Assistant who will be assigned to your case and who is also bound by the strictest oaths of secrecy. Rest assured, your location and the true nature of your presence here will be entirely confidential. We are very accustomed to sensitive cases, and we understand the unique dangers you face.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Then we have an agreement. I will arrive here tonight, under the cover of the discrete breathing spell you've suggested. I trust your ability to maintain my privacy, but I will also take my own precautions. As for the diagnostics, proceed as you see fit. I am... not... squeamish, and I can tolerate discomfort far better than most. Just be sure to inform me if there are any significant findings or if your prognosis changes in any way. I expect to be kept fully informed throughout this... 'procedure.'

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
Very well, Severus. Tonight, then. The discrete breathing spell is a good measure. I will ensure the ward is prepared and fully charmed by the time you arrive. A Healer Assistant, Elara, will be expecting you; she is fully aware of the secrecy protocols.

And yes, you will be kept fully informed. I will personally oversee the diagnostic charms, and I will be the one to interpret the results. Any significant findings, any changes in the Mark's signature, or any shift in our understanding of its nature will be communicated to you immediately. My priority is to understand this evolving curse and, if necessary, to stabilize it. Your input, as the subject, will be invaluable throughout.

Do you have any further questions before you depart, or are you prepared to proceed with the arrangement for tonight?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: No further questions. I assume you have a list of... instructions or restrictions for me to follow prior to the diagnostics? I have no intention of complicating your work, but I need to be clear on what is expected of me before I arrive. For instance, should I avoid certain types of magic in the days leading up to the procedure? Or are there specific conditions you need me to maintain for the Mark to be... most cooperative? I want to ensure that we get the best possible results from this... 'arrangement.'

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
Excellent question, Severus. Your foresight is appreciated, and it will indeed aid in obtaining the clearest readings.

Yes, there are a few instructions that would be beneficial. Primarily, I'd ask you to refrain from any intensely demanding or emotionally charged magical activity between now and your arrival tonight. Avoid casting complex spells, brewing high-level potions, or engaging in any duelling or strenuous magical exertion. The goal is to allow your magical core to settle into as neutral and stable a state as possible, so we can observe the Mark's natural fluctuations without external interference.

Regarding your physical state, simply maintain your usual routine, but perhaps avoid any particularly rich or magically enhanced foods. Stick to lighter meals. And unless you have a pre-existing medical condition requiring it, please refrain from consuming any potions or elixirs tonight or tomorrow morning, especially those that might influence your magical energy or mental state. We want to observe the Mark in an unadulterated state.

Essentially, we're aiming for a 'quiet' magical environment within you. This will allow the diagnostic charms to penetrate and differentiate the Mark's signature with greater clarity. It's less about the Mark being 'cooperative' and more about ensuring its intrinsic magical output isn't masked or stimulated by your own recent magical exertions.

Does that make sense, Severus? Are those conditions manageable for you?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Manageable? I can adhere to those restrictions with ease. The suggestion of avoiding complex spells or emotional magical activity is, in fact, a relief. I have little desire to engage in... unnecessary magical exertions under the current circumstances. As for the dietary restrictions, they are trivial. I trust your guidance, and I will comply with your instructions to the letter. This... situation requires the utmost attention to detail, and I am not one to…-cut corners, so to speak. I will be prepared, as you have directed. Now, if you will excuse me, I have... arrangements to make before I return here tonight.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
Very well, Severus. I appreciate your diligent cooperation; it will undoubtedly aid our efforts significantly. I understand you have arrangements to make.

The ward will be ready for you tonight, fully secured. Elara will be expecting you. We'll speak again once you're settled, and we can then begin the initial phase of the diagnostics.

Until tonight. Safe travels, Severus.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Until tonight. I... thank you for your... thoroughness. I assume we understand each other's... needs and expectations. I will not waste your time with... pleasantries. I bid you... good day.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
Indeed, Severus. Our understanding is clear, and our mutual expectations align. The priority is the precise analysis of the Mark.

Good day to you as well. I'll see you tonight.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I'll be... punctual. Good... day.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Understood. I will be ready.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Farewell, then.

Conscientiousness.behavioral_evidence: He states, "The only concern I have is that this... condition does not impact my ability to perform my duties. I cannot afford to be absent from Hogwarts." This highlights an extremely strong sense of duty and commitment.

Extraversion.behavioral_evidence: He explicitly says, "I will not waste your time with... pleasantries. I bid you... good day," indicating a disinterest in social warmth and a preference for directness.

Agreeableness.behavioral_evidence: He expresses limited trust, stating, "I trust your ability to maintain my privacy, but I will also take my own precautions," showing wariness despite verbal assent.

Neuroticism.behavioral_evidence: His repeated emphasis on secrecy and confidentiality, such as "ensure that you do not alert anyone to this... situation," reveals significant underlying anxiety about his vulnerability and reputation.
